title: 第260章 法医验尸第259章 碰瓷找事
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了第一卷：默认第260章法医验尸（..la）楚青辞收敛心绪，微微点头回应，语气平和：“你好，不知阁下怎么称呼？”
“我姓陈，单名一个阳字。”陈阳坦然回道。
楚青辞轻轻颔首，开口说：“陈先生，你也看见了，我现在有麻烦缠身，脱不开身。
你们要是想要采购丹药，改天再来拜访吧。”
说完，她就打算转身，继续处理眼前的纠纷。
陈阳见状，立刻上前一步，拦住她的去路，开口从容说：“楚阁主，你误会了，我今天不只是来买丹药，我还想帮你治体内重症。”
楚青辞闻言，面露诧异，抬眼看向陈阳，眼底满是疑惑。
一旁的陆霜瞬间脸色一沉，立刻厉声呵斥：“你好大的胆子！竟敢胡言……”
楚青辞立刻抬手拦住了她的动作。
被阁主拦下，陆霜只能强行压下心底的怒火，双臂环胸，眉眼冰冷，死死盯着身前的陈阳，浑身都透着不悦与戒备。
楚青辞目光落在陈阳身上，神色认真，开口追问：“你继续说，我身上有什么病症？”
陈阳目光平静扫过楚青辞的全身，透视之力悄然运转，一眼看穿她体内潜藏的隐疾，语气笃定开口：“你体内淤积常年不散的寒毒，深层寒症十分严重，已经侵入经脉本源。”
这话一出，楚青辞当场愣住，眼底写满难以置信。
她身中寒毒这件事极为隐秘，从未对外人提及半句，平日里寻医问诊、调理身体，全都是暗中悄悄进行，极少有人知晓。
她完全没想到，眼前这个初次见面的年轻男子，居然一眼就看穿了自己缠身多年的隐疾。
一旁的陆霜更是满脸震惊，瞳孔微微收缩。
阁主身中寒毒的秘密，整个丹仙阁只有她一人知晓，平日里她一直贴身照料、严格保密，万万没想到会被一个陌生少年轻易看破。
短暂失神后，楚青辞连忙压下心底的震动，带着几分急切追问：“你有对症药，可以帮我根治？”
陈阳轻轻摇头，语气坦然：“你这种根植经脉的陈年寒毒，普通丹药治标不治本，根本无法彻底根除。”
听到这话，楚青辞心底反而信了几分。

要是陈阳一上来就满口吹嘘有解药、有丹药可以根治，她反倒会认定对方是信口开河、借机攀附。
她自身本就是顶尖炼丹师，多年来寻访过无数名医高人，试过无数珍稀丹药和调理法门，但都能彻底根除这根植本源的寒毒。
楚青辞抬眼，满心好奇地看向陈阳，眉眼间满是疑惑：“那你要怎样才能帮我根治？”
陈阳从容开口解释：“我修炼的是阴阳调和功法，这套功法十分特殊，刚好可以制衡阴寒戾气，能够循序渐进，彻底根除你体内的陈年寒毒。”
楚青辞眼底的好奇更盛，带着几分不确定追问：“你确定真的能做到？”
陈阳重重点头，语气坚定自信：“我百分百有把握，只不过需要你全力配合我才行。”
楚青辞没有丝毫犹豫，语气诚恳认真：“只要你真的能彻底根治我的寒毒，无论需要我怎样配合，我都愿意。
只是……”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Awakening of the Yin and Yang Magic: I felt so good after the breakup, Volume 1: Default Chapter 260 Forensic Autopsy (..la) Chu Qingci calmed down, nodded slightly in response, and said in a calm tone: "Hello, what is your name?"
"My surname is Chen, and my given name has the character Yang." Chen Yang replied calmly.
Chu Qingci nodded gently and said, "Mr. Chen, you have also seen that I am in trouble now and I can't get out of it.
If you want to purchase elixirs, please come visit me another day. "
After saying that, she planned to turn around and continue dealing with the dispute in front of her.
Upon seeing this, Chen Yang immediately stepped forward, blocked her way, and said calmly: "Pavilion Master Chu, you misunderstood. I'm not just here to buy pills today, I also want to help you treat a serious illness in your body."
When Chu Qingci heard this, he looked surprised and looked up at Chen Yang, his eyes full of doubts.
Lu Shuang's face suddenly darkened, and he immediately yelled: "You are so brave! How dare you talk nonsense..."
Chu Qingci immediately raised his hand to stop her movement.
Being stopped by the pavilion master, Lu Shuang could only suppress the anger in his heart. He crossed his arms across his chest and stared at Chen Yang in front of him with cold eyebrows, displeasure and wariness all over his body.
Chu Qingci's eyes fell on Chen Yang, with a serious look on his face, and asked: "Go on, what disease do I have?"
Chen Yang's eyes calmly swept across Chu Qingci's body, and the power of perspective was quietly operating. He could see through the hidden diseases hidden in her body at a glance, and spoke with a firm tone: "Your body has accumulated cold poison that has been lingering for many years. The deep-seated cold disease is very serious and has invaded the origin of the meridians."
As soon as these words came out, Chu Qingci was stunned on the spot, his eyes filled with disbelief.
The cold poison in her body was extremely secretive, and she never mentioned it to outsiders. Her daily medical consultations and physical conditioning were all done in secret, and very few people knew about it.
She had no idea that the young man in front of her, whom she had met for the first time, could see through the hidden illness she had suffered for many years at a glance.
Lu Shuang on the side was even more shocked, and his pupils shrank slightly.
She was the only one in the entire Danxian Pavilion who knew the secret of the cold poison in the pavilion master's body. She had always taken close care of it and kept it strictly confidential. She never expected that a strange boy would see through it easily.
After a brief absence of consciousness, Chu Qingci quickly suppressed the shock in his heart and asked with some urgency: "Do you have the right medicine to help me cure it?"
Chen Yang shook his head gently and said calmly: "You have an old cold poison that is rooted in the meridians. Ordinary elixirs treat the symptoms but not the root cause and cannot be completely eradicated."
After hearing this, Chu Qingci actually believed it in his heart.
If Chen Yang had been bragging about having an antidote and a pill that could cure the disease when he first came up, she would have thought that the other party was just talking nonsense and taking advantage of the situation.
She is a top alchemist herself. Over the years, she has visited countless famous doctors and tried countless rare elixirs and conditioning methods, but she has been able to completely eradicate the cold poison that is rooted in her origin.
Chu Qingci raised his eyes and looked at Chen Yang curiously, his eyebrows full of doubts: "Then how can you help me cure it?"
Chen Yang calmly explained: "What I practice is the Yin and Yang Harmony Technique. This set of exercises is very special. It can just balance the cold and yin energy. It can completely eradicate the old cold poison in your body step by step."
The curiosity in Chu Qingci's eyes became more intense, and he asked with a bit of uncertainty: "Are you sure you can really do it?"
Chen Yang nodded heavily and said in a firm and confident tone: "I'm 100% sure, but I just need your full cooperation with me."
Chu Qingci did not hesitate at all, and said in a sincere and serious tone: "As long as you can really cure my cold poison completely, I will be willing to cooperate in any way you need me to.
Just..."
